A DIFFERENT MOBILE WORLD

Before the app store.
Beyond the familiar.

DoJa was the Java application environment behind a branch of NTT DoCoMo's i-mode software. The surviving catalog runs from familiar game series to small experiments, utilities, and applications that seldom traveled beyond their original phones.

This guide follows the entries explicitly labeled DoJa by Keitai World Launcher. Japanese source titles, patch labels, handset variants, and separate SD-data references stay attached to their records.

Meet the sources and preservation community ↗

WHERE THIS COLLECTION BEGAN

Dirge opened the door.

Dirge of Cerberus: Lost Episode was Wakka's starting point for building Android bridges. This archive returns to that beginning and opens the catalog around it.

The preservation work came first. This guide follows its trail.

Yuvi's account of restoring the full release describes the SD-card recovery effort and credits Naoya Shinota and other contributors. Their work, alongside the wider Keitai community, is part of the story behind the game reaching modern players.

Explore the Dirge record ↗Read Yuvi's account ↗
